1: # ADR 0015: Parameterized SQL 13-Month Audit Trail Explorer with Search Query Self-Auditing & JSONB Secret Redaction, Principal-Scoped In-App Notification Bell with Bounded Async SMTP Delivery (`FAILED_DLQ`), and Value-Typed Cross-Context Dashboard Widget Aggregator
2:

4: - **Status:** Proposed
5: 
6: <!-- An Accepted ADR stays. A later decision writes the next file and sets this line to "Superseded by ADR <NN>". Do not edit Decision or Alternatives after Accepted. -->
7: - **Deciders:** mdurana
8: 
9: ## Context
10: 
11: Story `P2-I` (`p2-i-audit-logs-notifications-and-dashboard-apis`) implements the cross-cutting compliance audit trail explorer, principal-scoped in-app notification bell with asynchronous SMTP email dispatch, and operational dashboard widget count APIs inside `com.example.app.audit` (`app/backend/`). It builds upon the append-only `audit_log_entries` and `notification_events` tables in `V2__iam_and_audit_schema.sql` (`P1-B`), the `report_runs` and `governance_tickets` tables in `V4__execution_and_governance_schema.sql` (`P1-D`), the fail-closed session and RBAC/View-As guards (`P2-A`, `P2-B`), and the execution & governance workflows (`P2-F`, `P2-G`, `P2-H`). Governing requirements from `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-i-audit-logs-notifications-and-dashboard-apis.md`, `docs/agents-v0/architecture.md`, `docs/agents-v0/design/system/components/audit-notifications.md`, `ADR 0001` (`docs/agents-v0/adr/0001-modular-monolith-architecture.md`), `ADR 0002` (`docs/agents-v0/adr/0002-openapi-v1-contract-conventions.md`), `ADR 0003` (`docs/agents-v0/adr/0003-iam-and-audit-persistence-schema.md`), `ADR 0005` (`docs/agents-v0/adr/0005-execution-freeze-and-governance-immutability.md`), and `ADR 0008` (`docs/agents-v0/adr/0008-iam-rbac-sod-and-view-as.md`) establish five non-trivial architectural and security constraints:
12: 
13: 1. **13-Month Online Audit Trail Explorer with Search Quer
<truncated 1244 bytes>
urred_at DESC, id DESC`.
16:    - `AuditLogService.recordEvent(AuditEventRecord)` (`AuditEventPort`) sanitizes all dynamic string attributes (`workspaceEmail`, `effectiveViewAsRole`, `eventType`, `actionName`, `resourceType`, `resourceId`, `outcome`, `correlationId`, `searchQueryText`, `clientIp`) with `Encode.forJava()`, recursively strips sensitive credential/secret keys (`password`, `secret`, `token`, `cookie`, `authorization`, `apiKey`, `clientSecret`, `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, `privateKey`) from `mutationPayloadJson` while normalizing valid JSONB (`{}` or structured JSON object), inserts an append-only row into `audit_log_entries` (guarded by `trg_audit_log_entries_immutable`), and deserializes `mutation_payload_json` into an expandable `Map<String, Object>` (`mutationPayloadJson`) on `AuditLogEntryDto`.
17: 
18: 2. **Principal-Scoped In-App Notification Bell Listing, Inspection & Read Mutations with Strict BOLA Enforcement (`GET /api/v1/notifications`, `GET /api/v1/notifications/{id}`, `POST /api/v1/notifications/{id}/read`, `POST /api/v1/notifications/read-all`, `AC-3`, `AC-4`, `AC-7`, `AC-8`):**
19:    - `GET /api/v1/notifications` (`listNotifications`) requires `AUDIT_NOTIFICATIONS_READ` (`audit:notifications:read` / `notifications:read`), scopes SQL strictly to `recipient_user_id = principal.userId()`, optionally filters to `is_read = FALSE` when `unreadOnly = true`, and orders deterministically by `created_at DESC, id DESC` using `idx_notifications_recipient_unread`.
20:    - `GET /api/v1/notifications/{id}` (`getNotificationById`) and `POST /api/v1/notifications/{id}/read` (`markNotificationRead`) load the target notification (`404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` if the UUID does not exist) and enforce **BOLA recipient ownership**: if `!notification.recipientUserId().equals(principal.userId())`, the service records `AUTHZ_DENIED` in `audit_log_entries` (`@Transactional(noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class)` per `L-004`/`L-005`) and refuses with `HTTP 403 Forbidden` (`errorCode = "AUTH_FORBIDDEN"`).
